owner_rulings.ruling: SDKs: IN the product boundary when required by customers/integrations, but distinguish distributable SDK artifacts from runtime-required components in the canonical release manifest.
owner_rulings.applied: component_class=distributable for sdk-python and sdk-typescript (no image, no runtime; never rendered into Compose/Helm); release-manifest.py PRODUCT_BOUNDARY + _check_class

owner_rulings.ruling: Extractor: IN the product boundary if any supported IntentGate capability depends on it. Determine this from actual dependency evidence rather than packaging assumptions.
owner_rulings.applied: IN, component_class=runtime, required: gateway intent stage and task binding depend on it (evidence in PRODUCT_BOUNDARY['extractor'] and design/RELEASE-BOUNDARY-IDENTITY-REGISTRY-2026-10-01.md §3)

owner_rulings.ruling: Use an isolated test identity mechanism appropriate to clean-room acceptance; do not depend on Joe's personal interactive account. Prefer an isolated Entra test tenant/app if the production authentication contract requires Entra. Do not weaken production authentication merely to automate installation testing.
owner_rulings.applied: the contract requires Entra (ODR-R1-002 CANONICAL_OPERATOR = tid + oid): an isolated Entra test tenant; design §5. The clean room stays RED until the owner provisions it.

owner_rulings.ruling: Support both authenticated registry installation and an offline/air-gapped image bundle eventually. Both must resolve the same signed canonical release manifest and identical digests. Do not make `latest` valid in either path.
owner_rulings.applied: pull-plan / verify-image-refs (registry) and assemble-image-bundle / verify-image-bundle igib/1 (offline); design §6

owner_rulings.ruling: If configured in a way that attributes automated calls to EUID-HUM-000001, classify RELEASE-BLOCKING and prepare the narrow correction. Do not deploy it.
owner_rulings.applied: the override is removed from the release config surface and refused by build, render, config-validate, verify-bundle, guard-release-input, verify-install and the chart
